headline: Morning Report: 3 Overdue Tasks and Data Quality Issues in Campaign 102

bullets.text: 3 tasks are overdue as of 2026-10-31.
Overdue T-1 'Uplift report for Autumn data bundle' (campaign 101) is in_progress, due 2026-10-24.
Overdue T-2 'Validate response attribution for Roaming pass promo' (campaign 102) is open, due 2026-10-30.
Overdue T-3 'Control group audit for Family plan upsell' (campaign 103) is open, due 2026-10-20.
Open T-4 'Win-back October: first results' (campaign 104) is due 2026-11-05, not overdue.
Campaign 102 has 15 duplicate response groups on (customer, campaign, date, revenue).
Campaign 102 has 94 response rows but only 79 distinct customers.
12 responses are dated before their contact date.
Campaign 103 has 25 customers appearing in both treatment and control.
6 responses have response_date > campaign end_date + 30 days, all dated 2026-11-10.
All 6 late responses belong to campaign 101 'Autumn data bundle' (end_date 2026-10-01).
Warehouse volumes: 4 campaigns, 4025 contacts, 306 responses.
Responses per campaign: 101=63, 102=94, 103=76, 104=73.
Campaign 101: treatment 57/900 = 6.33% vs control 6/100 = 6.00%.
Campaign 102: treatment 74/900 = 8.22% vs control 5/100 = 5.00%.
Campaign 103: treatment 69/900 = 7.67% vs control 7/125 = 5.60%.
Campaign 104: treatment 70/900 = 7.78% vs control 3/100 = 3.00%.
Policy: response counts only within 14 days after contact; treatment/control must be disjoint; holdout is 10% of base, never below 1000.
Wiki has 17 pages including data-quality-checklist, response-attribution, control-group-policy, uplift-methodology, incident-2026-08-duplicate-loads.
The known duplicate-load incident (ETL restart loading the same responses file twice) is the documented cause of such duplicates.
No column matching churn/retention/status exists in any table, so churn cannot be measured for Win-back October.
